'''Crop sprayers''' were [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used to dress [[barq]] fields after a harvest. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] used a [[Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer]] to transport a group of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to the planet [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].<ref name="HC" />
